description: Mattress Finder helps shoppers compare physical mattresses by sleep position, firmness preference, cooling needs, motion isolation, mattress size, trial length, warranty, and budget. It ranks options by fit, explains tradeoffs clearly, includes affiliate disclosure before outbound shopping links, and avoids medical diagnosis or treatment claims.

defaultPrompt: Find a queen mattress for a hot side sleeper under $1,500.
Compare mattresses for couples with strong motion isolation.
Find a firm king mattress with a long trial period.
